cards.t: THORChain Restarts Most Swaps After Halt
cards.b: THORChain restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and several other networks following a refund bug, while three chains remain paused.

per.RUNE: Resuming swaps for major networks removes a key operational bottleneck.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for restarting the remaining three paused chains

cards.b: NEAR approved a proposal to cut annual token issuance, preventing 11.8 million NEAR from entering circulation over two years.

per.NEAR: Lower token issuance passed, which may reduce future inflation but could impact staking yields.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST

cards.t: Winklevoss Files for Spot Zcash ETF
cards.b: Winklevoss filed for a spot Zcash ETF with a $100 million indication of interest.

per.ZEC: Filing for a spot ETF with institutional interest could increase adoption and demand.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Binance Resumes Withdrawals Following Security Checks
cards.b: Binance began phased multi-network withdrawal restorations following security checks after its October incident.

per.BNB: Platform recovery and withdrawal restoration help stabilize exchange operations.
per.ADA: Cardano withdrawals resumed via BEP20 network in phase 2.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full timeline for 100% asset replacement and complete withdrawal availability across all minor tokens

cards.t: Moscow Exchange to Launch Crypto Trading
cards.b: Moscow Exchange plans to launch Bitcoin, Ether, and USDT trading on December 1 under Russia's new law.

per.BTC: New regulated exchange listings in Russia open additional institutional and retail channels.
per.ETH: New regulated exchange listings in Russia open additional institutional and retail channels.
per.USDT: New regulated exchange listings in Russia open additional institutional and retail channels.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific trading pairs and volume limits details for all categories
